Carl Martin TOD Browse current products Find a dealer All about Carl Martin TOD When Dizzy Mizz Lizzy originally peaked in the early 1990s, guitarist Tim Christensen relied on a Boss Turbo Overdrive to craft his signature high-gain tone. The plan behind the Carl Martin TOD was to create an updated and improved version of Tim's original sound—a pedal that captures the essence of that era while offering modern refinement and reliability. The TOD high-gain overdrive was originally designed as the "Limited Edition Dizzy Drive," a special project celebrating Dizzy Mizz Lizzy's reunion tour. Only 500 original Dizzy Drives were built, and they sold out incredibly quickly in both Denmark and Japan. Given the overwhelming demand and the pedal's importance to Danish rock history, it only seemed fair to release the pedal again as part of Carl Martin's Classic Series. The TOD delivers powerful high-gain overdrive that cuts through any mix with thick sustain and rich harmonic content. Whether you're chasing Tim Christensen's aggressive lead tones or seeking your own high-gain voice, the TOD provides the drive, clarity, and punch that defined an era of Danish rock music. Finished in the iconic yellow color that made the original so recognizable, the TOD is both a tribute to Tim's legendary tone and a serious high-gain tool for modern players. Simple to use with standard input and output jacks, the TOD can be powered by a 9V battery or external power supply (not included), making it easy to integrate into any pedalboard setup. The Carl Martin TOD brings the classic Dizzy Mizz Lizzy sound back to life—ready to inspire a new generation of players. Specifications No specifications added yet.
